summary.text: James Malone is a Democratic state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 36 in Lancaster County since May 2025 and is seeking a full term on November 3, 2026. He is a former mayor of East Petersburg who worked in information technology.
Ballotpedia lists Republican Tom Jones, a state representative, as his opponent.

paragraphs.text: James Malone earned an associate degree from Northwest College in 1995 and a bachelor's degree from Lee University in 1997, according to Ballotpedia.
In a biography on his campaign website, he says he grew up in Wyoming, worked as a roofer to put himself through college, and had a long career in IT.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business application development and work as a business development analyst.
Before his election to the Senate, Malone served as Mayor of East Petersburg, according to his campaign website.
He took office in the state Senate on May 5, 2025, after a special election in which Ballotpedia lists him as defeating Republican Josh Parsons, 50 percent to 49.1 percent.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists his committees as Game and Fisheries, Aging and Youth, Agriculture and Rural Affairs, Communications and Technology, and Local Government.

His campaign site lists priorities including investment in public schools, lower costs of everyday essentials, support for small businesses and good-paying jobs, services for seniors, veterans and first responders, and access to mental health care.
